cases.case_label: SVA_F in BRCA1 intron 13 creating pseudoexons (hereditary breast cancer)
cases.mechanism_detail: Two cryptic splice donors within the 5' Alu-like domain of the SVA pair with a cryptic acceptor in BRCA1 intron 13, producing 509-bp and 666-bp pseudoexons in the BRCA1 mRNA (exons 12-15 RT-PCR in puromycin-treated lymphoblasts) that introduce a premature stop at codon 1558.
cases.quote: Sanger sequencing of the transcripts indicates that two cryptic splice donor sites within the 5’ Alu-like domain of the SVA element exploit a cryptic splice acceptor in BRCA1intron 13, resulting in exonification of segments of 509bp and 666bp in the BRCA1 message and a premature stop at codon 1558.
